meta.description:
✈️ From India to the breathtaking landscapes of Vietnam – join me on this exciting international journey! 🇻🇳✨

In this vlog, I’ll take you through:
✈️ The best ways to travel from India to Vietnam (flights, routes & tips)
💡 Visa process, ticket booking hacks & travel costs
🏙️ First impressions of Vietnam – culture, streets & vibes
🍜 A glimpse into the food, local life & must-know travel tips

Whether you’re planning your first Vietnam trip or just love travel content, this video will give you everything you need before you go.
